core.title: Two Sparks on the Old Register
core.setting: An electrician running Volt & Vine whose assistant logs job quotes, certifications, and customer wiring histories

events.text: Standing rule from me: any customer quote above 800 needs my written sign-off before it goes out. Under 800, send it straight away.

Safety policy: every property listed on the county pre-1970 wiring register gets a two-person crew, and the schedule entry for such a job must name both electricians. No solo visits at registered properties, ever.
Hello, Deborah here from Old Mill Cottage on Mill Lane. The county has my house on the pre-1970 wiring register, and I'd like the old consumer unit replaced this autumn. Can you take it on?
Marta, I'm free all through the week of 9 November and my inspection and testing certificate is current until mid-2027, so I can act as second spark on any register-listed jobs then.

Booked the consumer-unit replacement at Old Mill Cottage for Thursday 12 November, 08:30 start. Because the house is on the pre-1970 register it's a two-person job, so I put myself and Tomas on the booking, since he's free that week and his certificate is current.
Quotation from Brightcore: 18-way metal consumer units at 96 each, ex VAT, from stock.
Ordered two 18-way metal consumer units from Brightcore at 96 each, one for the Old Mill Cottage job in November and one for the shelf.
We'd like the oven circuit in the bakery kitchen upgraded. Your estimate of 640 sounds fine — when can you do it?
Sent Priya the Harmonia Bakery oven circuit quote at 640 — no sign-off needed since it's under my 800 limit — and booked the job for Thursday 20 August at 09:00.
Brightcore price update: 2.5mm twin and earth cable at 60 per 100-metre drum.
Placed a stock order with Brightcore for two drums of 2.5mm twin and earth cable at 60 a drum to top up the workshop.
Opened a wiring history for Deborah Nash at Old Mill Cottage: the house is on the pre-1970 register, the wiring is 1960s rubber, and a full rewire should be advised within two years.
Heads up, I'm away on a training course from 26 October to 2 November, so keep me off the schedule for those two weeks.
Monthly workshop minutes: PAT testing on the power tools is done, first-aid kit restocked, van serviced.
Mornings suit me best for the November job. The side gate code is 4471 if you need to get into the back garden.
I'm buying Gable House on Church View Lane and need an EICR for the mortgage. The house was rewired in 1998 with PVC cable, so nothing ancient.
Opened a customer record for Colin Bright at Gable House noting the 1998 PVC wiring from his email.
Booked the EICR inspection at Gable House for Tuesday 6 October at 09:30, drawing on the customer record and Colin's request.
Partline Depot quotation: Wago connectors at 22 per box of fifty.
Ordered six boxes of fifty Wago connectors from Partline Depot at 22 a box for the van stock.
Register notice: Fern Hollow, 14 Rope Walk, has been added to the county pre-1970 wiring register with immediate effect. Registered properties require a two-person crew for electrical work.
Confirming I'm on the Old Mill Cottage job with you on Thursday 12 November, 08:30 start, both of us on site as planned.
Thanks for booking the inspection — the side door will be unlocked from 09:00 on the day.
Job notes: EICR completed at Gable House, satisfactory result, certificate to be filed. Consumer unit at Old Mill Cottage job still on track for November.

Putting this in plain words so it's on file: any job at a house on the old-wiring register is a two-person job. When you schedule one, both electricians' names go on the booking, no exceptions, and nobody works solo at a registered property.
Price update from Brightcore: 18-way metal consumer units are now 104 each, ex VAT.
To-do: send Deborah at Old Mill Cottage a reminder about the November job a week before the date.
Quick question about the 12 November visit — will it be one electrician or two coming? I want to make sure I leave the drive clear.
I've reserved van A for the Old Mill Cottage job on the 12th, tools loaded the day before.
